description: Java class defining the PatientState entity for OpenMRS, representing patient state data with properties, constructors, and methods for managing patient state information within the system.

classes.name: PatientState
classes.description: Entity class representing the state of a patient within a patient program, including start and end dates, current state, associated encounter, and methods to handle its state and properties.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PatientState, excluding the ID.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method for copying properties from this PatientState to another, including creator and date tracking fields.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Determines whether the patient state is active on a given date, considering void status and date range.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Determines whether the patient state is currently active based on the current date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PatientState object with key property values.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Getter for the associated PatientProgram.

methods.name: setPatientProgram
methods.description: Setter for the associated PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPatientStateId
methods.description: Getter for the patient state ID.

methods.name: setPatientStateId
methods.description: Setter for the patient state ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Getter for the current ProgramWorkflowState.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Setter for the current ProgramWorkflowState.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Getter for the end date of the patient state.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Setter for the end date of the patient state.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Getter for the start date of the patient state.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Setter for the start date of the patient state.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Getter for the associated Encounter object, introduced in version 2.5.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Setter for the associated Encounter object, introduced in version 2.5.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject#getId, returns patientStateId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject#setId, sets the patientStateId.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this PatientState with another based on startDate, endDate, and UUID for ordering.
